utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the final list, but I’ll keep it simple and let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli — that works for me. Just let me know when the list is ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a quick hand with sorting donations and loading the van would help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that—just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait—are we definitely doing the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’m a little nervous about the timing and whether we have enough hands. If we’re doing it, we should probably confirm the schedule soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, can you confirm whether it’s this weekend? I just want to know if we’re actually on before I plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might be a bit foggy, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I’m keeping a list of what we still need, so I’ll let you know the missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Cleo. Just point me to whatever’s missing and I’ll do my best to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the details of the repair drive first? I want to make sure I have everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still pulling the details together. I’ll send you the repair drive info as soon as I’ve got it straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries — send it over when you have it, and I’ll take a careful look.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late as usual, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome — if you can bring a couple of screwdrivers, some duct tape, and maybe your drill if you’ve got it, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring the screwdrivers, duct tape, and my drill too. I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you bring your cordless drill and a few spare bits? If you’ve got a free hour, I could also use an extra pair of hands sorting the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll bring my cordless drill and some spare bits, and I can spare an hour to help sort the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not seeing any repair drive details yet, so I’ll keep an eye out and let you know where it’s happening once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — please do. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll work it around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep watch for the location and pass it along as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—people are pitching in with tools and spare parts. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess—please do. I’m telling folks fast, and I’d love to know the time and place as soon as you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Quinn—I’ll keep my ears open and let you know the moment I hear the time and place. Folks around here are really pulling together, so I’m sure news will pop up soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you got the repair drive details, or should I help gather them?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have them yet, sorry. If you want, we can gather the repair drive details together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what details do we still need to gather?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they need. If you want, I can let you know when I head over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’d really appreciate a heads-up when you’re heading over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll give you a heads-up when I’m on my way over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the repair drive schedule together now. If you know anyone who can help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll ask around and let you know if anyone can help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. Even one or two helpers would make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’m happy to keep an ear out and pass along anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll keep to my usual route and check in by the mailbox tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll do the same and let you know if I hear anything by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m in—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great—can you bring a few screwdrivers, some gloves, and any spare tape you’ve got? I’ll circle back with the exact list if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring screwdrivers, gloves, and whatever spare tape I can find. Just send the exact list if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, if you want—just tell me what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. The porch light still needs replacing, and the front step is loose—if you’re willing, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can handle both of those. I’ll start with the porch light and then take a look at the front step.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what’s the repair drive looking like?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the current locations noted down, so I can help keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — just point me to the spots and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Hana — I’m thinking we should keep the repair drive simple and well-organized so everyone feels comfortable helping out. I can help connect people if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Jules—simple and organized will help a lot. Could you send me the names of a few people you can connect, and I’ll check the details before we move forward?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send over a few names I can connect and keep it easy to review. Thanks, Hana; I’ll get that to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you help sort the donated tools and set up the tables? That’d make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that — sorting the tools and setting up the tables should be fine. Just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll check in if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you handle collecting the donated tools and bringing them to the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll collect the donated tools and bring them to the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need the details first—what needs repairing, where are we dropping things off, and by when?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s for the community repair drive at the hall—broken small appliances and bikes. Can you take them by Saturday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday afternoon works, but I’ll need the exact drop-off time and who’s receiving them at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great — I’m definitely in for the repair drive! I’ll tell a few neighbors and see who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll keep track of what we still need and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll start asking around right away and send anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school pickup times, so just let me know when the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Faye — that really helps. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the repair drive time sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — once you know, send it my way and I’ll plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. If you have any specific homes or tools in mind, tell me and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I don’t have any specifics yet, but I’ll ask around and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Nell — I appreciate you checking around. I’ll keep the list ready and update folks as soon as we have items to work on.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is happening so I can point folks there quickly. Do you know the exact location, Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s at the community center on Maple, near the playground. I’ll send you the exact room number in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll keep Maple and the playground in mind, and wait for the room number.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m happy to help however I can. What do we need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Honestly, we could use hands, tools, and a few spare supplies most of all. If you’re free, I’d love for you to swing by and help spread the word too!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that — I’ll stop by and help spread the word. Just tell me where to go and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still short on screws, wood glue, and a couple paintbrushes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our stock and set those aside if we have them. If we’re short, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m glad it’s happening; I can help if you need anything simple carried or sorted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—that would help a lot. I’ll check the list first and let you know what needs carrying or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Hana—just point me to the piles and I’ll do my best. I might need a quick reminder where to start, but I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive time before I can commit. What slot are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm thinking maybe late afternoon, but I should check the exact time first.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—just send the exact time when you have it, and I’ll see if I can make it fit around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. Could you bring the wrench set and the small drill if you’ve got them?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the wrench set and the small drill.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout. I’m running errands later, so I’ll stop by and see if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — could you check whether they still need batteries or tape?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask when I stop by and let you know if they still need batteries or tape.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple and make a clear plan for the repair drive. What time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Let’s start at 10 AM and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 AM works for me. I’ll be there and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great, Sam! Could you help sort donations and hand out flyers on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort donations and hand out flyers on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — we’re still on track. I’ll send you the latest details now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Leo — send it over and I’ll catch up right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, can you help sort the donated items and keep an eye on the sign-up sheet? That’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can sort the donated items and keep an eye on the sign-up sheet.
